data.name: Assumed Form
data.description: You can change your appearance at will, as disguise self with a caster level equal to your oracle level.

raw_tokens.value: You can change your appearance at will, as disguise self with a caster level equal to your oracle level.
You can choose to actually transform, which works the same way but counts as a polymorph effect instead of an illusion and doesn't allow a Will save to disbelieve.|PRECLASS:1,Oracle=7
The ability lasts until you dismiss it or use it again, allowing you to even keep it active while you sleep.|PRECLASS:1,Oracle=11
When you use this ability as a polymorph effect, you can gain the size bonus to your ability scores and additional racial abilities as if using alter self.|PRECLASS:1,Oracle=15
